verify.title: Verify your business to make offers
verify.pendingBody: A coordinator is checking your documents. Farmers see a verified mark on your offers once it is done.
verify.body: Farmers and coordinators only accept offers from verified buyers. It takes a GSTIN or trade licence and a few minutes.

home.description: Open requirements, active offers, orders in progress and payments due.
home.title: Good to see you, {{name}}

supply.title: Recommended supply
supply.description: Pooled lots and single harvests that fit what you buy, nearest and best-inspected first.
supply.empty: Nothing matches yet. Post a requirement and coordinators will pool supply towards it.

actions.title: Needs your attention
actions.emptyBody: Counter-offers, deliveries and payments due will appear here.

supply.title: Available supply
supply.description: Pooled lots and harvests open for offers.
supply.lede: Pooled lots from farmer groups and single harvests, open for offers. Inspected grades are checked by a coordinator.
supply.emptyBody: Try another crop or district, or post a requirement so coordinators pool towards it.

demands.title: Requirements
demands.description: What you need, where and by when.
demands.lede: Post what you need. Coordinators pool nearby harvests into lots that meet your grade, quantity and date.
demands.emptyBody: A requirement tells coordinators what to pool for you — crop, grade, quantity and delivery date.

form.future: Pick today or a later date
form.bothCoords: Enter both latitude and longitude, or neither
form.minQuantityHint: Leave blank to accept partial lots of any size.
form.targetPriceHint: Shown to coordinators as a guide, not a binding offer.
form.deliveryLocationHint: Warehouse, mandi yard or processing unit, as a transporter would find it.
form.coordsHint: Coordinates let MandiMate price transport to your door precisely.
form.paymentDaysHint: Shorter terms raise what farmers net — and your chances.
form.maxRejectionHint: The most you may reject at your quality check.
form.qualitySpecHint: Size, colour, ripeness, moisture — what your QC checks.
form.validFuture: Choose a time in the future

newDemand.postedBody: Coordinators can now pool supply towards it.
newDemand.title: Post a requirement
newDemand.lede: Tell coordinators what to pool for you.

lots.emptyBody: Coordinators link lots here as they gather harvests that meet your specification.
lots.unavailable: This lot is no longer visible to you.
lots.title: Lots pooled for you
lots.description: Farmer groups assembled against this requirement.

supply.emptyTitle: No open supply matches right now
supply.emptyBody: New harvests are listed daily — check back, or widen the grade.
supply.title: Matching supply
supply.description: Open lots and harvests of this crop and grade.

demand.cancelBody: Coordinators will stop pooling towards it. Offers you already made stay as they are.
demand.seo: Specification, status and the lots matched to this requirement.

offer.sentLot: The coordinator reviews it, then each farmer gives consent.
offer.sentHarvest: The farmer will review your terms.
offer.unverifiedTitle: Your business is not verified yet
offer.unverifiedBody: Sellers see offers from unverified buyers with a caution mark.
offer.buyerPickupBody: You send a vehicle to the collection point and pay for transport. Farmers pay nothing to move the produce, so more of your price reaches them.
offer.deliveryBody: MandiMate books a truck to your door. The fare is shared by the farmers' pool and deducted from their proceeds — price accordingly.
offer.deliveryHintPickup: Where your vehicle takes it — for the record and the farmers.
offer.deliveryHintMandimate: The truck delivers here. Add coordinates for an exact transport estimate.
offer.paymentHint: Each day of waiting costs farmers interest.
offer.handlingHint: Sorting or packing you deduct, per kg.
offer.demandHint: Linking fills in your delivery and payment terms.
offer.notesPlaceholder: Anything the seller should know — crates, timing, contacts.

landed.yourVehicle: Your vehicle — add your own cost

offer.submitNoteLot: Binding once the coordinator and every farmer consent.
offer.vsMandi: vs selling alone at the mandi
offer.transportUnknown: Add delivery coordinates to include the transport estimate.
offer.farmerNote: Farmers compare this net — not your headline price — with selling alone. Shorter payment and lower rejection lift it.
offer.farmerEmpty: Enter a price and quantity to see what farmers would take home.
offer.title: Make an offer
offer.description: Price, quantity and terms for a lot or harvest.
offer.lede: Farmers weigh what they take home after transport, handling, rejection and waiting for payment. Clear terms win lots.
